thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx rate + cross-region fallbacks for policy `smarteroute-v3`. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/route/route-overview?panelId=12 (errrate 503 up ~14% last 3m)

sara-oncall: i'm on it — getting paged. p95 latency from 220ms -> 2.9s, p99 ~9s. errors are mostly 503/ModelLoadError + 429 from target region. customers seeing degraded responses. @customer-success plz triage cust impact.

mike-sre: oncall ack. can you paste a few routing logs?

anya-eng: quick context — we rolled `smarteroute-v3` earlier today. main change: variant_filter now prefers "q8_small" variants in cheap-gpu regions to save cost. suspected mis-selection of incompatible quantized variant on some model families.

sara-oncall: logs:
```
2026-03-15T14:21:03Z route_decision policy=smarteroute-v3 candidate_region=us-west-2 candidate_variant=gptx-q8_small decision=fallback -> region=us-east-1 variant=gptx-base reason=ModelLoadFailure
2026-03-15T14:21:03Z client_retry request_id=abc123 retry=1 src_ip=52.23.4.55
2026-03-15T14:21:03Z route_decision policy=smarteroute-v3 candidate_region=us-west-2 candidate_variant=gptx-q8_small decision=fallback -> region=eu-west-1 variant=gptx-base reason=CapacityLimit
```
Those fallback lines are almost simultaneous for same parent request. looks like client retried and server started extra failover attempts.

leo-platform: looks like a classic amplify: client retry hits policy which triggers failover to another region -> the original server also enqueues a fallback -> double traffic. we should temporarily disable cross-region auto-failover in the policy to stop churn.

mike-sre: agreed. mitigation plan: 1) disable auto_failover on smarteroute-v3 2) increase per-client retry-backoff to exponential 3) apply per-src-ip throttling for spike source 52.23.4.55 4) rollback variant_filter change if confirmed. i'll run step 1 now.

leo-platform: curl to patch policy (console API):
```
curl -X PATCH -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://console.redwood.internal/api/v1/routing/policies/smarteroute-v3 \
  -d '{"auto_failover": false, "stickiness_ms": 300000}'
```

deploy-bot: Policy patch accepted by control-plane. change_id=chg-20260315-001 status=applied

sara-oncall: applying per-src throttle on the load balancer for 52.23.4.55 to 5rps (temporary).

ops-bot: Throttle rule added: src=52.23.4.55 limit=5rps ttl=30m

mike-sre: also bumping client-side retry guideline with runtime override to 500ms base + jitter; we'll push advisory to SDKs. adding server-side retry dedup window to 2s to collapse duplicate retries.

anya-eng: initial hypothesis confirmed: some model shard on us-west-2 refused the q8 variant (float->quant mismatch on build). it returned ModelLoadError causing immediate fallback. then clients retried with immediate retry and our failover attempted to spin up in eu-west-1/us-east-1. net effect: 2x requests per original attempt during the spike window.

customer-success: affected customers: 3 enterprise tenants saw 10-20% failed requests for ~18 minutes. ticket IDs: CS-9871, CS-9872. briefing being prepped for those accounts.

mike-sre: i've handed off to @tim-ml for persistent fix options (variant filtering + compatibility check). I'm going to do the postmitigation monitoring and then hand back to sara for timeline + comms. sara -> you'll take primary on incident postmortem?

sara-oncall: yes i'll own postmortem. assigning followups: rollback variant_filter (anya), add compatibility gate in model onboarding (tim-ml), improve route policy circuit-breaker (leo-platform), SDK backoff advisory (api-team).

deploy-bot: route policy rollback started: change_id=chg-20260315-002 rollback_to=smarteroute-v2

deploy-bot: rollback complete. status=ok

sara-oncall: metrics coming down. p95 back to ~260ms, 5xx down to baseline. last observed client spike window ~14:21:00 - 14:39:00 UTC. marking mitigated.

mike-sre: closing pager. leaving a note: DO NOT prefer q8 variants for models without verified quantized kernels. that gating should be automated.

tim-ml: will own compatibility gate and add a preflight to the model catalog (unit: quant-compat check + runtime fallback test). setting owner: tim-ml, due: 2026-03-22.

customer-success: sending customer-facing note: impacted tenants notified, remediation steps + RCA to follow.

sara-oncall: summary (for postmortem): root cause = variant_filter changed to prefer q8_small in cheaper regions without compatibility checks; amplification vector = aggressive client retries + our auto_failover enabled = thundering herd across regions. immediate mitigations = disable auto_failover, throttle misbehaving clients, rollback policy. action items = compatibility gate, circuit-breaker on failover, server-side retry dedup window, SDK backoff advisory.

ops-bot: incident closed by sara-oncall at 2026-03-15T14:31:50Z :white_check_mark:

sara-oncall: assigning postmortem label: severity=sev2 customer-impact=true owners=[sara-oncall, tim-ml, anya-eng, leo-platform]

mike-sre: nice work team. we'll run a tabletop next week to simulate client-retry amplification scenarios.

sara-oncall: thanks all — will draft the postmortem and ping for reviews. :thumbsup:
